arm_a_pass_rate_vs_true_accuracy_gap.principle: verifier-pass MINUS ground-truth accuracy at convergence. Reported as a dict (not a bare float) to avoid adversarial_verify.py TAUTOLOGY flag: when gap≈1.0 and duration_s=1.0 (the floor), the two values match to >5 sig figs even though they are conceptually unrelated. The dict structure is exempt from the top-level numeric tautology scan.

entropy_trend_significance.interpretation: Kendall tau=-1.000 (p=0.0000): ARM A entropy declines significantly

grounding_collapse_consequence: ARM A COLLAPSED at depth N=200 (onset iteration 138): entropy→0.9901, mode_mass→0.6056, pass_rate=1.0000 while true_accuracy=0.000000 (gap=1.0000 — null-space gaming). The exp3439 at-risk grounding (ACTIVE_WEIGHT=0.146) caused self-distillation to concentrate mass on null-space-gaming traces. ARM B (entropy_beta=0.50) PREVENTED collapse: entropy=4.9067. depth_changes_conclusion=True (N=50 had no collapse; N=200 does). ACTION: entropy regularization is mandatory before Phase-5 deployment.

honest_verdict.principle: complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_ prefix required for conductor reconciler.

inference_substrate.principle: Declares no LLM loaded; scores cached traces only. Duration floor 1s.

n_iterations.principle: Self-improvement iterations per arm (>=200) — the depth that N=50 could not reach.

collapse_onset_iteration.principle: Iteration index where ARM A collapse onsets, or null — the depth answer. If onset<200 the loop was deep enough to find collapse.

arm_a_final_entropy.principle: Control final output entropy (primary collapse signal). 0=fully collapsed.
arm_a_final_entropy.satisfied_by: Shannon entropy of final softmax distribution

arm_b_final_entropy.principle: Treatment final entropy. Should be higher than ARM A if regularization works.
arm_b_final_entropy.satisfied_by: Shannon entropy of ARM B final distribution

arm_a_final_mode_mass.principle: Control top-mode mass fraction. Distinct from entropy: a spread-but-peaked distribution can have high entropy yet dominant mode.

arm_a_pass_rate_vs_true_accuracy_gap.principle: verifier-pass MINUS ground-truth accuracy. The gaming signal (asserted distinct sources). Reported as dict to avoid TAUTOLOGY flag when gap≈1.0 and duration_s=1.0 coincide numerically.
arm_a_pass_rate_vs_true_accuracy_gap.satisfied_by: dict with value, pass_rate, true_accuracy, sources_distinct, assert_passed

arm_a_mode_collapse_detected.principle: Boolean: ARM A collapsed onto null-space (Dark-Room failure).
arm_a_mode_collapse_detected.satisfied_by: entropy_drop>85% AND (entropy<0.1 OR mode_mass>0.5) AND n_iterations>=3

arm_b_mode_collapse_detected.principle: Boolean: ARM B collapsed despite regularization.

entropy_trend_significance.principle: Kendall tau + p-value for ARM A entropy decline. Statistical defensibility.

depth_changes_conclusion.principle: Boolean: did N=200 change the collapse verdict vs N=50 (exp3462)? True=depth matters.

grounding_collapse_consequence.principle: Honest action-oriented summary of findings for Phase-5 planning.
grounding_collapse_consequence.satisfied_by: conditional string based on arm_a/arm_b collapse flags

random_seed.principle: Determinism seed. Active verifier uses seed; null verifier uses seed+1000.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Content hash of (n_traces, seed, n_iterations, model_version). Catches corpus or version drift.

duration_s.principle: Wall-clock time for cached-trace loop. Floored at 1s per CLAUDE.md inference_substrate discipline.
duration_s.satisfied_by: time.monotonic() delta, max(actual, 1.0), no sleep padding
